events.text: In -34500 DR, Isstosseffifil rose to prominence on the eastern shore of the Narrow Sea.
In -33800 DR, the Isstosseffifil empire's wizards rerouted the Narrow Sea in an effort to drown the phaerimm inhabiting Phaerlin.
Around -31000 DR, the batrachi were losing a war against the titans.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: The Time of Dragons: The first dragons begin spreading across Faerûn. They soon establish the realms of Argissthilliax, Caesinmalsvir, Darastriverthicha and Tharkrixghontix.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Fall of the Aearee Empires. Led by the powerful dragon general Nagamat, the dragons destroyed the empires of the avians.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: The great giant god Annam All-Father marries Othea, a lesser demigoddess of Toril. Their union produces eight terrestrial children. The giant realms of Ostoria, Darchar, Grunfesting, Helligheim, Nedeheim and Rangfjell are founded by Annam and his sons.

Araushnee is banished from the elven pantheon and cast into the Abyss. Her son Vhaeraun (who was also banished) and daughter Eilistraee (who chose exile) start wandering on Toril. Araushnee makes a new home for herself named the Demonweb Pits and becomes the demon-goddess Lolth.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: The giant realm of Ostoria was founded on the super continent Merrouroboros.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Within a few centuries of their arrival on Faerûn, after some of the dragons reached maturity, the giants recognized the great reptiles as powerful and cunning interlopers who threatened their very existence. Soon open warfare rages between giant and dragonkind with the rich resources of Faerûn awaiting the victor.
The Draco Holy Wars begin when religious factions among dragons began to fight over their different philosophies. The most violent conflicts were those fought among the followers of Asgorath.

The Dragonfall War begins when followers of Xymor kill Nagamat, sparking the war between the followers Bahamut and Tiamat which continues unabated in the present day. Tiamat began to breed aberrant creatures known as of the Spawn of Tiamat, and unleashed them on the followers of Bahamut. To counter them, Bahamut created the dragonborn to act as his soldiers and knights.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: While dragons and giants battled, members of the smaller humanoid races began to carve out their own civilizations.
The Colossal Kingdom reaches its height, stretching across Faerûn from the Cold Lands to the Vilhon Reach.
In circa -28000 DR, Ostoria reached the peak of its power, beginning the age known as the "Reign of Giants."
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Trying to undermine dragon rule, the Fey opened planar gates to allow the first elves to immigrate to Toril. Although most elves were content to remain in small scattered tribes, one group of dark elves known as the Ilythiiri negotiated with dragons to allow them to carve out a small kingdom in the south.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: The Thousand Year War: An avatar of Garyx led red dragons to invade Ostoria. Eventually all of dragonkind was drawn into the conflict.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Othea, mother of giantkind, pursues a series of unsatisfying affairs with various powers such as Vaprak, father of the ogre race.

Draconic philosophers came to the conclusion that religious fighting was wasteful and that gods who allowed such behavior were not worthy of their worship. This started the dragon's apathy toward their gods, which lasted for thousands of years. Due to this, it was speculated that several members of the original draconic pantheon just died due to the lack of worship.
Circa -26000 DR, the dragon god Garyx sent an avatar to lead a flight of red dragons to attack the giant nation, an assault that led to the burning and destruction of a cloud giant city.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: The Thousand Year War was a conflict between dragonkind and the giant nation of Ostoria.
Othea begins an affair with Ulutiu, a minor sea god of the Savage Frontier. The union of Othea and Ulutiu ultimately produces four races: firbolg, verbeeg, voadkyn, and fomorian.
Durothil took a silver dragon mount and became the first known dragonrider.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Elf survivors of the Kingdom of Tintageer (a realm of Faerie) summon the power of elvish High Magic and escape from Faerie to Toril, and found the first elven nation on Faerûn.
cites: Evermeet: Island of Elves: MMP, с. 93–96

events.text: The elves from Tintageer defeat the great red wyrm Mahatnartorian, Master of the Mountains, although Durothil also died in the battle.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8
Evermeet: Island of Elves: MMP, с. 132–136

events.text: During the first Rage of Dragons, circa -25000 DR, Caesinsjach and her fellow dragons destroyed Darastriverthicha and all its vassal states.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 9

events.text: Ostoria reaches a truce with dragonkind and the Reign of Giants comes to an end. Ostoria has shrunk to only a shadow of its former self. The Colossal Kingdom now occupies only the northernmost edge of Faerûn (present day Great Glacier and the Cold Lands).
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Draconic legends first speak of Ironfang Keep, a stronghold built on the cliffs of the White River, overlooking the Dragons’ Sea.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 20

events.text: First Rage of Dragons: Elves created the Dracorage mythal in a citadel in the northernmost reaches of Toril, tying it to the appearance of the King-Killer Star. This powerful magic incited dragons across Faerûn to madness and mindless destruction, turning them against each other and even against their offspring.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Around -25000 DR, the Dracorage mythal was created as a concerted effort of elves.

Legends tell that either, Tiamat or the green dragon Caesinsjach, created the first of the dragonspawn, Kurtulmak. Soon afterwards, new kinds of dragonspawn began to appear, among them the kobolds and the urds.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 9
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Kobolds from Darastrixhurthi discovered Garl Glittergold's gem caves, where the god had stored the soul-gems that contained the souls of the gnomish race. The kobolds enslaved the gnomes.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 9

events.text: Destruction of Darastriverthicha: Dragons affected by a Rage destroyed the dragon realm of Darastriverthicha.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 9

events.text: Destruction of Darastrixhurti: Garl Glittergold rescued the gnomes while the dragons attacked Darastriverthicha, and then destroyed Darastrixhurti, killing all the kobolds living there and creating the Hidden Lake. Seeking to compensate and protect the kobold and urd races, Asgorath elevated Kurtulmak and Kuraulyek to godhood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 9

events.text: Around -24500 DR, Lolth’s attention was directed to Toril through the intrusion of Kethryllia into her Demonweb Pits.

End of the Time of Dragons: Desperate, a few of the remaining dragon lords try to destroy the Dracorage mythal. Brave avariel defenders sacrifice their lives to protect it, and the dragons are unable to stop the magic fueling the Rage. The avariel race is almost wiped out during this battle.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 20

events.text: The great wyrms of the southern lands continuously assault the cities of Mhairshaulk, causing the yuan-ti realm to fall.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Lolth's attention is drawn to Toril for the first time in history, due to the elf Kethryllia Amarillis fighting the demon Haeshkarr in the Demonweb Pits. The Spider Queen begins to seduce dark elves and takes Ka'Narlist as her consort.
cites: Evermeet: Island of Elves: MMP, с. 140–156
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Occidian is sacked by a horde of orcs led by Haeshkarr, which then attacks Sharlarion. The invaders are defeated by the elves at great cost.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: The forest community of Sharlarion survived the First Sundering nearly intact. As the elves multiplied, they migrated into neighboring forests, hills, and lowland regions. Soon the gold elf kingdom of Aryvandaar, in the present day High Forest is established.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: Establishment of the first settlements of the gold elf and moon elf kingdom of Shantel Othreier in the Green Fields.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: An outpost of Shantel Othreier is established in the Ardeep Forest by the moon elves.
Establishment of the first settlements of Ilythiir in the Shaar and Forest of Amtar.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: Around the time of -23200 DR, Ilythiir's territory included the Shaar and the Forest of Amtar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Establishment of the settlements of Syòrpiir in what will become the Ankhwood and Chondalwood.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: First settlements of the kingdom of Illefarn are founded in Ardeep and Kryptgarden Forests, and parts of the Dessarin valley. Wild elves join their moon elf cousins in Ardeep.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: Founding of the kingdom of Orishaar in the Duskwood and the Shaar.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: Establishment of the nation of Thearnytaar in the Thornwood.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: Establishment of the settlements of Eiellûr in Winterwood.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: First skirmishes between Orishaar and Ilythiir begin, and continue off and on for seven millennia.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: Evidence from carvings in some sea caves suggests that the merfolk, locathah and sahuagin exist in Serôs and have battled each other since this time.

During this time Ilythiir was on generally good terms with the newly founded elven nations, despite skirmishes with Orishaar that started around -20000 DR, which flared up and abated for about 7000 years.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Establishment of the first settlements of Miyeritar in the High Moor and Misty Forest, by wild elves and dark elves due to political differences with the gold elves of Aryvandaar.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29
Evermeet: Island of Elves: MMP, с. 164

events.text: Some Ilythiiri houses discover Ghaunadaur and begin venerating him in secret.
Around -18000 DR, some Ilythiiri nobles discovered Ghaunadaur as a suitable patron for them.

Establishment of the first settlements of Keltormir in Forest of Tethyr by moon elves and wild elves Thearnytaar and elsewhere, seeking peace and simple lives away from the strife of the other elven realms.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: The First Sundering occured. Hundreds of High Magi gathered in the heartland of Faerûn at the Gathering Place. Ignoring the lesson learned from the destruction of Tintageer centuries earlier, the High Magi cast a spell designed to create a glorious elven homeland. As the Day of Birthing dawned, the spell reached its apex. The unbridled force of the spell sundered Faerûn, the one land, apart. As a result, hundreds of cities were washed away, thousands of elves lay dead, and the face of Abeir-Toril was changed forever. The name Faerûn, no longer the one land, was given to largest continent and E
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: The Tree of Souls is given to the elves.

The First Sundering (sometimes simply the Sundering) or Ever'Sakkatien (as called by the Tel-quessir) was a High Magic ritual cast by the greatest elven high mages of the Tel-quessir during the period of the First Flowering, around -17600 DR.

Merrouroboros was fractured by the First Sundering, forcing a continental plate westward across the ocean and leaving the proto-Moonshaes behind it. During this time, the archipelago was unrecognizable as the future Moonshae Isles, and was little more than a collection of hundreds of islands formed by volcanic peaks. The giants of Ostoria were the first settlers of these isles, building massive structures in the mountains and bringing ettins, trolls, ogres, dire wolves, and winter wolves with them.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31
Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 162–163

events.text: Around -17600 DR, the First Sundering to create the aforementioned dark elf-free land was cast, the continent was destroyed as collateral damage.
The independent sylvan realms of Thearnytaar, Eiellûr, and Syòrpiir open discussions of unifying the elves of the Satyrwood.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: Around -17500 DR, three elven realms, Thearnytaar, Eiellûr and Syòrpiir made steps to unify themselves into a single nation.

Start Of The War Of Three Leaves. The unification of the Satyrwood is thwarted by dark elven Ilythiiri spies and assassins, killing their leaders and framing opposing heirs, driving the three realms to a multi-front war. Ilythiir's influence is not discovered for centuries.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: By -17100 DR, the three nations' relationships to each other deteriorated so far that they started the War of Three Leaves among themselves.

Numerous elves abandon the surface realms of Eiellûr and Syòrpiir during the War of Three Leaves to settle in the Selmal Basin (Vilhon Reach). This begins the elven migrations, which continue for seven millennia.

End Of The War Of Three Leaves. Thearnytaar, Eiellûr, and Syòrpiir remain separate realms after peace is restored, though each of the three continue skirmishes among themselves and with Ilythiir for centuries.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: The Vyshaan clan rises to power in Aryvandaar under Coronal Ivósaar Vyshaan.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: Fey began settling the Moonshaes. By this time, the giants of Ostoria had abandoned the Isles and the Earthmother had already come to inhabit the land.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31
Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 162–163

events.text: Aryvandaar's rulers begin attempts to diplomatically and peacefully annex Miyeritar into their realm and under their control.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: In -14700 DR, the rulers of Aryvandaar started trying to annex Miyeritar, initially through peaceful and diplomatic means.
Miyeritar becomes the center for elven Art and High Magic on Faerûn.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: Skirmishing and trade interference starts between Aryvandaar and Miyeritar.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: The Crown Wars Begin/Rise Of The Vyshaantar Empire. After centuries of fruitless diplomacy, the impatient, grasping rulers of Aryvandaar attack Miyeritar and begins putting political pressure on Shantel Othreier to join them or suffer the same fate.

The first dwarven settlements appear in the great mountain range known as the Yehimal, which lies at the juncture of the three great continents of Faerûn, Kara-Tur, and Zakhara. From there, the earliest dwarves migrated into all three lands.
From the great migration, one isolated branch of dwarves settle amid the isolated peaks of the Novularond, eventually becoming known as the arctic dwarves.
The first great kingdom of the dwarves of Faerûn is centred in the great cavern of Bhaerynden, deep beneath the Shaar.
cites: Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark

events.text: The First Crown War was a conflict fought between the elven realms of Aryvandaar and Miyeritar in northwest Faerûn in the 12th millennium before Dalereckoning.
At the start of the Crown Wars (-12000 DR), Aryvandaar began pressuring Shantel Othreier to accept Aryvandaar occupation following the invasion of Miyeritar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 29

events.text: By -11800 DR Aryvandaar had fully annexed and occupied Miyeritar though some parts continue to resist.

Miyeritar militarily occupied and annexed by Aryvandaar, though a number of clans and strongholds resist and continue to fight. Many elves of Illefarn, despite its officially-neutral stance, provide secret safe-havens for Miyeritaran refugees.
In -11800 DR, secret safe havens were provided to former Miyeritari citizens by elves of Illefarn.
In -11800 DR, Miyeritar lost the First Crown War against Aryvandaar.
In -11800 DR, the Aryvandaarans seemed to have won: their forces occupied and formally annexed Miyeritar.
Around -11700 DR, the kingdom was destroyed by the Ilythiir kingdom of dark elves during the second war of the Crown Wars.
The Ilythiiri destroy Syòrpiir by fire, separating them from their allied neighbors and burning their homes to the ground.
Around -11600 DR, resistance against Aryvandaar re-flared in Miyeritar.
In -11600 DR, the kingdom was destroyed by the dark elf kingdom of Ilythiir during the second war of the Crown Wars.

Thearnytaar and Eiellûr band together and declare war on Ilythiir, decrying their use of fire and wanton destruction far more than the power plays of the northern elves. They fight a holding action, preventing the Ilythiiri from advancing north.
Lolth sends the balor lord Wendonai to seduce a high Ilythiiri clan into her service, and the church of Lolth begins to rise in prominence.

The Sable Wars. Thearnytaar and Eiellûr, with minimal allies from Keltormir and Shantel Othreier, invade Ilythiir, intent on destroying or reforming the dark elves before more realms fall. More than half their forces are decimated by the corrupt magics of the dark elves.
During the second Crown War Keltormir participated in the Sable Wars in -11450 DR, aiding Eiellûr and Thearnytaar with Shantel Othreier.
During the Second Crown War, Shantel Othreier participated in the Sable Wars in -11450 DR, aiding Eiellûr and Thearnytaar with Keltormir.

Fall of Eiellûr as the Ilythiiri once again use fire to destroy their realm around them and isolate them from aid. They were also helped by traitor green elves, who thought their appeasement actions could help restore peace.

The Crown Wars see a sudden influx of elves entering Serôs, forcing the elves out into the sea and away from the coastal waters. This ignites the first major conflicts with merfolk and sahuagin. [Sea of Fallen Stars]
The betrayers of Eiellûr are rewarded by the Ilythiiri with a tract of jungle overlooking the River Talar, which will become known as the Misty Vale. The survivors become known as the Or'Tel'Quessir.
Around -11400 DR, the kingdom was isolated from its allies and destroyed with fire by the dark elves of Ilythiir.
By -11400 DR, Eiellûr was isolated and burned down like Syòrpiir.
End Of The First Crown War. Miyeritar conquered by Aryvandaar.

Thearnytaar falls to the savage and now-unrepentant dark elves, who use enslaved monsters and undead to occupy the thorn-and-bramble choked woods. Ilythiir now directly skirmishes with the major realm of Keltormir along its eastern and southern expanses.

With another major migration to Serôs following the fall of Thearnytaar, the sea elves expand militarily beyond the Selmal Basin and establish the kingdoms and regions of Coranthys, Tor Meraliir, Ullythan Reef and Ryeniir.
Around -11200 DR, the kingdom was destroyed by the dark elf kingdom of Ilythiir during the Second Crown War.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 30

events.text: Rise Of The Aryselmalyr Empire. Coryselmal, the grandest of the sea elf cities of Selmalyr, an elven nation of the Selmal Basin, becomes the capitol of the Aryselmalyr Empire over all the elf kingdoms in Serôs. The Aryselmalyr Calendar marks Year 1.

Dwarves from the great stronghold of Bhaerynden, under the leadership of Taark Shanat the Crusader and his eight sons, begin to establish the first holds of Deep Shanatar in the southern Underdark, below what will be the Lake of Steam and the Almraiven Mountains. These will eventually become known as shield dwarves.
The Leviathan, first of the Earthmother's Children, arrived in the Moonshaes.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: In -10900 DR Aryvandaar, now the Vyshaantar Empire, ceased talks with Shantel Otheier and invaded, starting the Third Crown War.
The fallen solar Malkizid becomes the secret patron of the Vyshan lords.
The Third Crown War. Accords finally fail between Shantel Othreier and Aryvandaar, now known as the Vyshaantar Empire, who immediately go to war.

The Cloaker Wars. The followers of Shanat come under attack by the mysterious inhabitants of Rringlor Noroth, who rose from the depths of a great chasm in a battle for control of the caverns of Alatorin. The Stout Folk eventually prevail, after Taark slew four blue dragons who claimed the Rift of Dhalnadar as their demesne.

Rise of Shanatar. The Wyrmskull Throne is formed, and Taark Shanat renames the wyrm's lair Brightaxe Hall and founds the kingdom of Alatorin. Shield dwarves mark the founding of Alatorin as the beginning of the First Great Age of Shanatar.
The Battle of the Gods' Theater was a costly conflict during the Crown Wars.

The Battle Of The God's Theatre. The God's Theatre (modern day Tunlands) on eastern Shantel Othreier is the site of one of the largest and costliest of all the Crown Wars' battles. Nearly 70,000 elves died at the hands of elven or orcish enemies, as an orc horde 100,000 strong fell upon the already-embattled elves. Aryvandaar won the day, and occupied the northern half of Shantel Othreier.
The illithid city of Oryndoll is founded by refugees from Glyth.
cites: Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark

events.text: Shantel Othreier conquered by the Vyshaantar Empire of Aryvandaar after the mysterious death of Coronal Ynloeth. Guerrilla fighting and rebel mages arise in parts of Miyeritar and the newly conquered territories. Only Ardeep, a vassal realm of Shantel Othreier, does not fall to the Vyshaan.

The Dark Disaster. Miyeritar is engulfed in killing storms, which reduce this entire forest and realm into barren wastelands in three months. While no proof could ever be found, many believe the High Mages of Aryvandaar inflicted the Dark Disaster on Miyeritar.

Due to the Dark Disaster, the larger part of the followers of Eilistraee--a major patroness of Miyeritar--die in the cataclysm, a blow from which the goddess and her church won't recover for millennia.

The elven realm of Ardeep is finally conquered by Aryvandaar. In the hundred years it takes the Vyshaan to bring this land under their hegemony, they slay two of its rulers, Ilitharath and his grandson Tarosspur.
Shock over the Dark Disaster established an uneasy four decades of peace, as nearly every elf of Faerûn shrank back in awe and horror from what havoc the Crown Wars wrought.

The eight sons of Taark Shanat set off to found their own kingdoms in the caverns to the north (beneath modern-day Tethyr and Amn). Each son claimed one of the children of Moradin as his patron deity and so each of the subkingdoms they established became tightly linked with the church of that particular god or goddess.
The Moonshaes began forming into their current shape. The Korinn Archipelago was formed.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: The LeShay founded the kingdom of Sarifal, constructing the city of Karador on an island in the center of the lake within Myrloch Vale.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: The elves of Keltormir, opposed on both sides by the Vyshaan of Aryvandaar and the dark elven clan Hune of Ilythiir, strategically withdraw from eastern Keltormir, holding their lines at Highlands’ Edge.
By -10300 DR Keltormir had withdrawn its forces west, holding a defensive line at Highlands' Edge, because of being pinned between the forces of Aryvandaar and Ilythiir.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 31

events.text: The Stone And Claw Campaigns. The withdrawal of Keltormir's forces to close and defend its own borders pitted forces of Aryvandaar and Ilythiir against each other. They soon closed ranks and fought incessantly for two centuries. Battles raged across the giant-infested mountains and wemic-claimed plains north of Keltormir.

In opposition to the corrupt dark elves of Ilythiir and their continued destruction of the forested elven homelands by fire (an elven enemy of long-standing), over 1,000 priests and High Mages of Illefarn and other free areas spend decades in fervent prayer for salvation by Corellon Larethian and the Seldarine.
Through enslaved dragons and other powers, the dark elves of Ilythiir engulf all of Shantel Othreier in flames, destroying over 70% of its trees over the course of 50 years.

Descent Of The Drow. Corellon's magic, as directed through his priests and High Mages, transforms the dark elves, now only found in the form of the corrupt Ilythiiri, into the drow. Whether by magic or by weakness that banish them from the sunlit lands, all drow retreat within two months’ passing into the Underdark.
Elves are summoned by the Seldarine to the site that becomes Elven Court one month after the Descent of the Drow, to settle differences and restore the peace among the elves.
Kamerynn, second of the Earthmother's Children, arrived in the Moonshaes.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: Aryvandaar's covert persecution of High Mages and priests begins, as they attempt to destroy or control any who might somehow force their descent as they did the drow.

While not destroyed utterly, Illefarn & its colony in the Llewyrrwood is annexed by Aryvandaar as its nobility of priests and High Mages died under the persecution of the increasingly-crazed Coronal Giilvas Vyshaan. Many elves of both lands flee to the remnants of Shantel Othreier.
In -9900 DR, under control of House Vyshaan and the leadership of Coronal Giilvas Vyshaan, Aryvandaar attacked Illefarn and its Llewyrrwood colony.
Garrison towers built among the Sharkstooth Mountains, with the help of Vodos the Great Builder.
Construction begins on the Sharksbane Wall, uniting the existing tower garrisons, by the clergy of Deep Sashelas, Trishina and Eadro.
Start Of The First Serôs War. The burgeoning empire of elves allies with the merfolk against sahuagin of eastern Serôs.

End Of The First Serôs War. This war destroys the major sahuagin kingdom in "Sekolah’s Trench" (the Trench of Lopok). Wars and skirmishes continue across centuries to slow or stop the building of the Sharksbane Wall.

The Vyshantaar Empire’s forces occupy all elven realms (save Keltormir) from the High Forest of Aryvandaar to the sweltering southern forests of Ilythiir. They begin the colonisation and settlement of Evermeet.

A large force of Llewyrr elves escape the oppressive mainland and resettle in isolation and safety among the mountains of the Moonshae Islands. Their new land becomes Synnoria, after the elfqueen who led the Llewyrr to this island sanctuary.
The Yuirwood is settled by small numbers of Sy'Tel'Quessir in the aftermath of the Crown Wars.

The rise of the first drow civilizations in the Underdark beneath southern Faerûn and their constant harassment of the Vyshantaar forces over the next five centuries help prevent Aryvandaar annexing Keltormir or any other lands.
Guallidurth, ancient city of the drow, is founded under the lands later known as Calimshan.
cites: Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark

events.text: Llewyrr refugees began arriving to the islands and are welcomed by the LeShay. The refugees settled in the mountains of Sarifal to form the kingdom of Synnoria.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: The Fifth Crown War Begins.

The First Proclamation of Elven Court leads to the revolt of the nobles of Aryvandaar and the last Crown War begins. The Elven Court, the Seldarine priesthoods, and the long-hidden High Mages restore pockets of resistance and freedom across the entire Vyshantaar Empire, fragmenting the armies and nobles to limit their coordination.
The solar Malkizid abandons House Vyshaan and retreats to the lower planes.
In -9200 DR, the surviving priests and High Mages came out of hiding to oppose Aryvandaar in the Fifth Crown War.
The Fifth Crown War Ends.

The Vyshaan are utterly defeated and Aryvandaar is dissolved. Much of the High Forest is abandoned for an age, leaving the forest open so the gods might restore its peace. The madness of the Vyshaan clan compelled even their most fervent followers to abandon them before all the elves lay dead at their hands. While the final fate of the Vyshaan elves is not recorded, most Tel'Quessir believe them dead and executed at the hands of Elven Court. Still, some rebellious elves across the centuries whisper tales of the four sons of Vyshaan who escaped to the west and to the stars to quietly marshal th
The Pack, last of the Earthmother's Children, arrived in the Moonshaes.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: In the year -8350 DR a splinter tribe of the ancient Durpari began to settle the then-fertile basin of the Raurin Plateau.
Around -8100 DR, the Mindstalker Wars between Shanatar and the illithids of Oryndoll caused Barakuir to become cut off from the rest of Shanatar, preventing reinforcements from arriving.
The Mindstalker Wars, also known as the War of Cloven Thoughts, were a series of wars fought between the illithids of Oryndoll and the dwarves of Shanatar.
Dwarven refugees from Shanatar founded Dwarvenhome in the caverns beneath the islands.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: In -7891 DR, the Imaskari annexed and enslaved the kobold kingdom of Zexthandrim in the Mountains of Copper, demanding tribute from the subjugated people in gold and gems.
In -7800 DR, the Djen arrived, along with their human and halfling slaves, in the area around where Calimport would later stand.
Around -7700 DR a number of marids and janni rebelled and fled the Calim Empire, splashing into the Vilhon Reach and the underwater Selmalyr, causing a brief conflict with the native sea elves.
By -7690 DR, the Calim Empire had expanded north to the southern banks of the River Agis.
In a similar move shortly after -7690 DR, the marid Ajhuu rebelled from Calim and founded the Maridlands in the eastern empire.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: By the time Calim noticed the treachery and reoriented his forces in -7687 DR, Ajhuu was well-established and fought to maintain his independence, leading to the Steam Clashes.
The Steam Clashes, Steam War, or Ajhuutal Mutiny was a short war between between the great genie Calim and his rebellious vassal Ajhuu, pitting the Calim Empire against the Maridlands.
The Shattering was the magical destruction of the Maridlands, Ajhuutal, and Ajhuu himself, culminating the Steam War with Calim and the Calim Empire.
Around -7600 DR, the great cavern of Bhaerynden collapsed, leading to the downfall of the drow empire of Telantiwar.

In -7403 DR, the Empire became determined to punish the demihumans' treachery, and expelled them from their tunnels using two new kinds of golems: slow-moving portal golems, carrying a portal in their chest, and smaller, shepherd golems, which would force the kobolds through those portals.
cites: Dragon 349: The Horde: Barbarians of the Endless Waste, с. 54

events.text: Dwarven settlers founded Highhome in the Cambro Mountains.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: In -6800 DR, the efreeti Memnon arrived north of the Agis and began constructing the country of Memnonnar.
In -6779 DR, there was a peasant rebellion in Raudor, which was soon put down.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 18

events.text: The Era of Skyfire, also known as the Genie Wars, was a time in Faerûnian history when the efreeti Memnon and the djinni Calim brought their forces together against each other in twenty-two cataclysmic battles from -6500 DR to -6100 DR.
In -6422 DR, rampaging krakentua razed the capital, Inupras.
By -6060 DR the last of the genies were driven out by humans and dwarves, and the human nation of Coramshan was founded by Coram the Warrior, combining the remains of the two fallen empires.
Grond Peaksmasher arrived in the Moonshaes, accompanied by a tribe of giants. They settled on Norland in the South Jotunhammer Mountains.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: The Clash at Earthrift was a battle of the Giant Wars that took place at what would be known as the Gorge of the Fallen Idol, fought between the giants of Nedeheim and the allied dwarves of Shanatar and elven kingdoms.
Ambril's Bane was a small battle between a handful of humans and dwarves in the 55th century before Dale Reckoning that caused the Shanatar Wars.
The Giant Wars were fought between the giants of Nedeheim and the dwarves of High Shanatar from -5360 DR to -5350 DR.
By -5330 DR, continuous expansion saw six of the empire's great cities built across its lands.
Around -5330 DR he marched with an army from Keltar, traveled around the Calim Desert and the Marching Mountains, and killed or press-ganged the nomadic peoples he encountered.

By -5300 DR, Murabir Mir had conquered the area around Iltakar up to the Wurlur (the dwarven defense made further northern conquest unappetizing) and west of the Darthiir Wood, founding the Kingdom of Mir as a separate but closely allied entity to Coramshan.
Circa -5100 DR, Mintar began life as one of many garrisoned fortresses that were established by the armies of the First Kingdom of Mir.

By -5100 DR, the kingdom had conquered all of the lands south of the Wurlur in a generations-long invasion of High Shanatar, taking the dwarven lands around the Omlarandin Mountains and extending the frontier east.
Circa -5100 DR, Saelmur began life as one of many garrisoned fortresses that were established by the armies of the First Kingdom of Mir.

Sometime in the 25 years following the Mirran army's defeat at the hands of Jhaamdath in -5032 DR, on the plains north of the tiny fishing town of Ankhapur, Mintar along with the other Mirran fortresses were overtaken by the Jhaamdathan army as they pushed the Mirrans all the way back to garrisons at Fort Saradush.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 15
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 40

events.text: The Mir–Jhaamdath War was a lengthy war in the First Age of Calimshan between Mir and Coramshan against the realm of Jhaamdath, which ultimately led to the formation of the Calimshan Empire.

Sometime in the 25 years following the Mirran army's defeat at the hands of Jhaamdath in -5032 DR, on the plains north of the tiny fishing town of Ankhapur, Saelmur along with the other Mirran fortresses were overtaken by the Jhaamdathan army as they pushed the Mirrans all the way back to garrisons at Fort Saradush.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 15
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 40

events.text: In -5007 DR, after a year long siege on their eastern fronts, the leaders of Mir and Coramshan came together for negotiations and came to the conclusion that only unification of their states would ensure survival against Jhaamdath.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 40
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 15

events.text: In -5007 DR, after a year long siege on their eastern fronts, the leaders of Mir and Coramshan came together for negotiation and came to conclude that only unification of their states would ensure their survival against Jhaamdath.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 40
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 15

events.text: Conflict erupted between the dwarves and firbolgs of the Isles. Underneath Ice Peak on Oman's Isle, Grond Peaksmasher was imprisoned. Without his guidance, the firbolgs of the Moonshaes grew increasingly uncivilized.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: Circa -4700 DR, nobles from Sharrven in turn split off to found another realm, Eaerlann, with the intent of opposing the ambitions of Siluvanede by claiming the ruins of Aryvandaar before they could.

The Seven Citadels' War was a series of skirmishes between Siluvanede and allies Eaerlann and Sharrven, three elven realms based around the High Forest in northwest Faerûn, fought between c. -4500 DR and c. -4300 DR.
In -4370 DR a suspicious plague known as the Silent Death decimated Lower Imaskari cities.
Around -4000 DR, the duergar of Barakuir rebelled against their slavers and liberated themselves.
In -4000 DR, the elf Kahvoerm Irithyl drew the Rulers' Blade, became Coronal of Cormanthyr, and united Elven Court, Semberholme, and Jhyrennstar as one nation.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 27

events.text: Artificers from Imaskar were frequent visitors in the Royal Court of Sarifal, leading to a belief that an alliance was established between the two realms.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: The city of Cormanthor was founded by Coronal Kahvoerm Irithyl as the capital city of Cormanthyr, the empire that united the elven lands of Semberholme, Elven Court and Jhyrennstar. Coronal Kahvoerm summoned the Rule Tower with the elfblade known as the Rulers' Blade, a ritual that was soon repeated with the Warblade and the Artblade, forming the three towers of Castle Cormanthor.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 33
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 55

events.text: In -3830 DR, Eaerlanni elves began to teach their magic to the humans of Netheril, which birthed their obsession with arcane magic.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: In -3533 DR, the Nether Scrolls were discovered by Finder, a Netherese human, within the area once controlled by Aryvandaar.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 5
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 33

events.text: In -3392 DR, King Horgar Steelshadow II created the Deepkingdom by unifying the duergar clans in and around Gracklstugh.
In the year -3389 DR they sent out a fleet of ships, very few of which returned.
In -3149 DR, it became the kingdom of Songfarla when its population exploded with an influx of more refugees.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29
Dragon 349: The Horde: Barbarians of the Endless Waste, с. 56

events.text: Circa -3000 DR, Sloopdilmonpolop was founded by Sloopdilmonpol, a great kuo-toa prophet, as a temple-city in the Underdark off the coast of Tethyr.
cites: Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark, с. 119
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: In -2954 DR, Ioulaum created the first floating enclave, Xinlenal, by means of the spell Proctiv's move mountain.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 6–7

events.text: In -2825 DR, the elves stole a set of Nether Scrolls, establishing a delicate balance of power among the nations that lasted millennia.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 24

events.text: Around roughly -2700 DR, the peoples of these lands constructed the Gate of Iron as a barrier against the approaching Imaskari forces.

During the Second Age, the Shanatar Wars came to an end around -2600 DR when the Calimshan Empire (led by the aggressive Tavihr Dynasty) finished the expulsion and extermination of dwarves from the surface, marked when the dwarven rearguard perished on the banks of the Sulduskoon River while sealing an entrance to Deep Shanatar.
In -2600 DR the Matron mothers of Maerimydra commissioned the building of the Twisted Tower as a beachhead in the Realms Above.
On the continent, the remains of Ostoria rapidly collapsed following the sudden expansion of the Great Glacier.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: In the distant past, Kultaakarr was a subkingdom of Ostoria and was lost beneath the ice with the advance of the Great Glacier around -2550 DR.
In -2550 DR, the death of the god Ulutiu caused a large region of Faerûn's north (present-day Pelvuria) to freeze, which led Ostoria to be slowly swallowed by the Great Glacier.

In -2489 DR, the manifestations of the Untheric and Mulhorandi pantheons landed on the highest peaks in a range of mountains on the northeastern edge of the Imaskar Empire known today as the Teyla Shan, or Godswatch Mountains.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: In -2488 DR, Lord Ilphemon, along with a small retinue of servants and family, fled the destruction of Imaskar for the Underdark.
In -2488 DR, the empire of Imaskar collapsed, and without leadership all the subject states of the Golden Water failed and descended into barbarism, with the Durpari reverting to a nomadic lifestyle.
In the year -2475 DR, the continual expansion southwards of the Great Glacier covered Vaasa and its neighbors with thick ice, driving out the inhabitants.
In -2368 DR, the Empire of Netheril established the frontier trading outpost of Quesseer, which would become frequented by seafarers of Illusk.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Circa -2320 DR, a clan of Rashemi migrated north and settled in the alpine valleys of the Armridge Mountains.
In -2270 DR, King Connar IV led the forces of Ammarindar into the High Forest to defend the elves from the demonic hordes that had been unleashed by the fey'ri survivors of Siluvanede.
Around -2200 DR Baphomet-worshiping cultists of Ammarindar created the Labyrinth, which was later abandoned and taken over by baphitaurs.
cites: Perilous Gateways: The Shadow Path: Labyrinth

events.text: The lovers referred to as the "Guardian Paramours" underwent the process to become the first baelnorns, dedicating their existence to the protect the city and its coronal.
In -2100 DR, Illuskan refugees first migrated to Icewind Dale and settled.

The Beast Kazgaroth was unleashed by Malar to wreak havoc on the Moonshaes for the first time. The Children of the Earthmother united with the Llewyrr and dwarves to battle the Beast. Fomorians were brought to the Moonshaes from the Feywild by Kazgaroth as allies. The conflict dragged on for decades until the minions of Kazgaroth were driven to isolated corners of the Moonshaes, where the fomorians conquered the firbolgs, forcing them into slavery.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: In -1967 DR, war broke out between Mulhorand and Unther.

By the Third Age of Calimshan (-1900 DR) Mir was one of the core kingdoms of the empire, alongside Coramshan, Tethyr, and Iltkazar (the early Mir territories around the Omlarandin Mountains were granted to Iltkazar), each ruled by the pasha in Calimport while more distant lands such as the Calishar Emirates were governed locally.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 15,16

events.text: In -1850 DR, the Underspires launched a series of attacks against various Underdark races, including the cities of Undraeth and Oryndoll.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 34

events.text: The Dragon's Wrath was a destructive blaze that tore through the city of Calimport in the year -1783 DR, caused by the jaws of Ylveraasahlisar, the Rose Dragon.

Because the Deep Netherese enslaved all the Serôsians who wandered near, the High Mages of Aryselmalyr destroyed Deep Netheril by transforming the crystal domes into a substance that burns in water. The subsequent explosion created Saerloon Bay and Selgaunt Bay.
The Cajaan Vengeance was a great fire that struck the city of Calimport in the year -1403 DR, lit during fighting between humans and beholders.
In -1288 DR, Melairbode was established in the mountain beside and underneath Aelinthaldaar by the dwarven King Melair I, who began mining mithral there.
In -1250 DR, the nation of Unther waged war against both the Deep Kingdom and the elves of the Yuirwood.
In -1200 DR, a trio of nycaloths, rumoured to have been sent by Netherese wizards testing the elves' defenses, rampaged across the woodland realm.
In the year -1081 DR the Theurgist Adept Thayd opened a portal to a world populated by gray orcs.
In the year -1076 DR, the humanoids invaded Mulhorand and Unther, beginning what later became known as the Orcgate Wars.

The Battle of the Gods was a conflict between the Untheric and Mulhorandi pantheons against the Orc pantheon, as well of one of the major battles in the ongoing Dragonfall War, that took place in -1071 DR as part of the Orcgate Wars.
By the -1064 DR, the capital of the Kingdom of Ashanath – Shandaular was built.
